raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 14 was delivered twice: the 02:00 load has ISO txn_ts strings, and a 05:00 re-delivery carries the same transactions with txn_ts as epoch milliseconds (1768716261000 = 2026-01-18 06:04:21 UTC, an exact match for txn 904490). The CAST to TIMESTAMP fails on the epoch values, and if they were parsed alone, the ~338 duplicate txn_ids (5165 rows vs 4827 distinct ids, all in the 676-row batch 14) would double-count the 2026-01-18 totals.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.85, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS WITH parsed AS (SELECT txn_id, customer_id, merchant_id, amount, status, batch_id, ingest_ts, CASE WHEN regexp_full_match(trim(txn_ts), '[0-9]+') THEN epoch_ms(CAST(trim(txn_ts) AS BIGINT)) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS ts FROM raw_transactions), dedup AS (SELECT * FROM parsed QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC) = 1) SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, ts AS txn_ts, CAST(ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM dedup WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
